snippet.title: Yule Dads Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Players can wishlist Yule Dads on Steam now - https://store.steampowered.com/app/5190390/Yule_Dads/

Yule Dads is a love letter to the skateboarding games of the PS2 era. Players will grind handrails, escalators and balconies, land tricks with names like the Corkscrooge, Yule Log and Rudolph Nosegrind, and drift corners for speed boosts. Up to eight friends can compete online, and up to four can play together locally.

Party mode combines gift hunts with 13 minigames, including Snowball Fight, Hot Coal, Grind Gauntlet and Capture the Candycane. Further modes include Man Flu, in which one player starts infected and everyone they touch joins them, as well as Free Ride, Time Attack, Style Attack and more. Optional rules such as low gravity and big heads let players customise the chaos. The soundtrack features indie punk bands from Norwich.
